performanceComparison.delivery: Vite development SVG editor, unchanged e2e/performance.spec.ts at 200 components/400 wires. Same host; managed browser/build jobs sequential. React development runtime is included.
performanceComparison.decision: Preserve the existing dense-zoom limitation and every outcome. Initial current p95 249.9ms, ordinary repeat 200.0ms; matched profiled pair 166.7ms both with means 158.75ms current/155.93ms HEAD. Limited samples do not establish persistent new slowdown or production speed. Existing assertions pass; no relaxed threshold or 60fps claim.

fullCheck.result: final application logic and source-alias presentation: types/lint/2224 units across145 files pass; later Lab Console-count CSS and harness have refreshed types/lint and affected source/built/production recovery

publicationPreparation.authorization: User separately requested committing and pushing the completed checkpoint to GitHub after local functional closure. No Cloudflare deployment or live-site authorization.

formatting.result: Six files normalized by Biome; TypeScript syntax trees, CSS rule/declaration structure and parsed JSON remain equivalent to the accepted staged versions.

catalogueReference.result: 116-entry exact snapshot passes after matching generator output to the commit formatter, following the existing model-inventory pattern. Earlier formatter-only byte comparison failure retained in the ledger.

publicationPreparation.scope: Formatting and inventory-tool normalization only; prior browser, static and performance evidence is retained with its original scope. Normal commit hooks required; publication is verified separately using Git refs.

exceptions: Retain historical solver p95 45.07ms/8ms and generator timing. Preserve historical zoom199.9ms plus every new current and baseline measurement, including initial249.9ms.
